boundary: Actual linked BoardImageExporter with WPF offscreen rendering and real JPG/PNG encoding; synthetic in-memory images and isolated fixture files only. No user data or live UI.

cases.name: export crops outside empty canvas and contains image pixels only
horizontal edge joins export without a control gutter
vertical edge joins export without archive buttons or selection chrome
intentional gaps retain the opaque board background
overlap follows document order rather than selection
archives do not affect bounds and their images are never loaded
empty and archive-only boards fail before loading images
a missing active image fails rather than exporting an incomplete board
images retain aspect ratio in a mismatched legacy layout
board zoom does not change exported geometry or mutate the document
invalid active geometry is rejected without image decoding
large dimensions and sparse-board pixel budgets fail before decoding
source pixel budget rejects a lazy oversized source before rendering
declared source budget is checked before image loading
duplicate immutable image files are decoded once and reused
PNG encoding round-trips dimensions and exact flat colours
JPG encoding round-trips dimensions and readable flat colours
successful overwrite replaces the complete image and leaves no temporary file
failed replacement preserves a locked destination and removes its temporary file
format and extension errors preserve an existing destination
a directory collision fails without leaving partial image output
